decisions.reason: The XL package is a cheap tier extension of the established anamnesis app, and demand from growing dental groups and multi-site practices is still uncertain, so the option costs little to keep open.

The dedicated support service for dental assistants builds on the firm's core service strength and costs little to run alongside existing support, and nothing so far shows its value will not be realized.
The materials management module was launched only in 2024 and is only mentioned on the website, so its value is still highly uncertain, and keeping it as a module of the core software is inexpensive.

The KIM secure messaging service is tied to mandatory telematics infrastructure, is being actively updated, and is close to a regulatory necessity for dental practices, so abandoning it makes no sense.
